notes.title: What’s Been Happening + Update 3.0.1 – Room Editor & Y-Axis Inversion
notes.content:
[p]Hello, fellow motel owners.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for your patience during the long wait for this update.[/b][/p][p]
I sincerely apologize for the delay, it shouldn’t have taken this long. Unfortunately, I suffered an injury in May that required surgery. I had to wait a month for and finally had the surgery in June. Since then, I’ve been focusing on recovery and was mostly confined to bed for nearly a month.[/p][p][/p][p]Despite these challenges, I’ve continued working on the game whenever I was able to, and I’m happy to say the update is now complete. I truly appreciate your understanding and support during this time, it means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]Please rest assured that we never abandon any of our games, and we’re committed to bringing you more unique content in the future.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s get into the details of this update:[/p][list][*][p]You can access the Room Editor from your tool wheel.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/6d3a13c96a1ea8c49b61c099324b205f3f074373.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]You can now move built rooms around.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/502065961901f4aa8389d3bc70591ddf70055bbc.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]You can destroy any built room and recycle its furniture and supplies to use them again.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/8ceaaed1a4eca8a5d4968e49b2471eb8c10c1b26.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]You can also assign custom room numbers to built rooms.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/679aab80d984f224f1aad7a49b4c34c45b5affc5.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A mouse Y-axis inversion option has been added to the Settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/7b7f7ecb0ecd3f26c584de7e5a222c8b8e1d59d4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The room editor is fairly new, if you encounter any bugs, please let us know via the forum or our [url="https://discord.com/invite/DsyUsE8HCs"]Discord[/url]. You can also send the save file to [url="https://onesliceofpizzagames@gmail.com"]onesliceofpizzagames@gmail.com[/url], we will solve it for you. Thank you.

We listen to your feedback and we will work hard to bring the updates to the game to make it better.

Join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/DsyUsE8HCs"]Discord [/url]if you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions.

[b]If you like the game, please leave a review, that really helps us, thank you so much![/b][/p][p]

notes.title: Update 2.0.1 - Sandbox Mode
notes.content:
Hello, fellow motel owners,

the sandbox mode is finally here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/f1937764f7d17641b405f6fdfc19f12114d00667.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Sandbox mode does not have any quests. We provide you with a detailed tutorial guide on how to run your motel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/f78cd9c97ef99dc73038d40efdb35ed606d2760e.png[/img]

[*] The store and restaurant are unlocked at the start. You can also build the employee cabin and hire employees from the start of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/1a2db006360663c1f282066bbf99dce3c5bf4b6c.png[/img]

[*] You can purchase upgradeable services at the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/ff08901de3aba8082476919f428718d768ba22ac.png[/img]

[*] In the Sandbox mode, there are no room or parking lot level requirements to level up, you can level up simply by improving the reputation of your motel.

[*] The save files of sandbox mode and original mode are separate and do not affect each other.
[/list]

The sandbox mode is fairly new, if you encounter any bugs, please let us know via the forum or our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DsyUsE8HCs]Discord[/url]. You can also send the save file to onesliceofpizzagames@gmail.com, we will solve it for you. Thank you.

We listen to your feedback and we will work hard to bring the updates to the game to make it better.

Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DsyUsE8HCs]Discord [/url]if you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions.

notes.title: Roadmap of Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
Hello, fellow motel owners.

Four days ago we released an update that changed the time speed and the pace of the game, and since then we have been fixing all the bugs you reported, and now the game is stable.

We are also working on the [b]sandbox mode[/b] at the same time. Yesterday, one of our Discord members asked if we had a roadmap for future updates. I think it's important to let you know what we are working on and what future updates will bring to the game. Here is the roadmap:

[list]
[*] 1. We will release a quality of life update tomorrow, we implement some features based on the feedback from you.

[list]
[*] Answer calls from anywhere without picking up the phone.
[*] A UI element that shows how long fuel will last in the boiler.
[*] Sell items in your warehouse that you no longer need.
[/list]
[*] 2. We will release the sandbox mode, which will not have any quests or restrictions on how you expand your business.

[*] 3. We will work on these features because they need a lot of testing to avoid potential bugs.

[list]
[*] You will be able to move/destroy rooms you built.
[*] You will be able to reassign room numbers.
[*] Other features that come from the feedback we collected from you.
[/list]
[/list]
Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DsyUsE8HCs]Discord [/url]if you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions.

[b]If you like the game, please leave a review, that really helps us, thank you so much![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 - Time Speed Settings and More
notes.content:
Hello, fellow motel owners,

In this update,

[list]
[*] We added a time speed setting to the game. You can control how long a day is using the slider we added in the settings menu.

[*] We slowed down the default time speed by 2x because we've heard a lot of feedback from you guys that time in the game was passing too quickly, which was stressful. If you don't like the current default time speed, you can adjust it using the slider in the settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/093e7819f3e5171296464236e1b3ca03df219ffd.png[/img]

[*] Now you can adjust the room prices easily each day with a single click.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/c913e3fcc913d0f23e1f17586ed86bba299d64c1.png[/img]

[*] We adjusted the prices of all the level 1 upgrades so you can unlock them quickly and grow your business empire sooner.

[*] We adjusted the difficult and intrusive quests so that leveling up in the early and mid-game will now be easier.

[*] We increased the working speed of your cleaner employee, now he/she will work faster even at a lower level.

[*] We increased the working speed of your receptionist employee.
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs, please let us know via the forum or our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DsyUsE8HCs]Discord[/url], thank you.

We listen to your feedback and we will work hard to bring the updates to the game to make it better.

notes.title: Gameplay Updates: Ice Fishing, Commercial Hunting, Ice Mining and Sauna Rooms
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are getting closer to the game release date! Please add the game to your wishlist to get notified when the release day comes.

We have been working hard on Arctic Motel Simulator and I would like to share some updates with you all!

[h1]1. Ice Fishing[/h1]
You will be able to ice fish different Arctic fish species in the game. You can sell the fillets in your motel store or cook them in your restaurant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/fc4da961f3d2f77761cbc41a3308eb35947c73b2.png[/img]

[h1]2. Commercial Hunting and Ice Fishing[/h1]
You can offer commercial hunting and ice fishing experiences to your motel customers. Purchase the ticket machines and make a ton of money while your customers have a great time in your motel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/1354c342d30e7fb0960d890501e785039cb4f79b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/3f1032517fb553f9e32b49ef945c48c57c047fe1.png[/img]

[h1]3. Ice Mining[/h1]
You can harvest ice in the Arctic forest and build the igloos with it. All the furniture in the igloos will be made of ice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/6838c94790299cf75c30bfd931ff167672aeba68.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/152ecfdacc3a4d9af2aa355b69808903a40b0003.png[/img]

[h1]4. Sauna Rooms[/h1]
Who wouldn’t want to enjoy a warm sauna during a cold Arctic winter? You can build Sauna rooms in the game and provide your guests with a unique experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102938/7bb53751193047f2d31c9eb471696d7d20aef7bf.png[/img]

Thank you for reading, we are working hard to bring Arctic Motel Simulator to you as soon as possible. Please stay tuned. Don't forget to wishlist the game! ːsteamhappyː
